consequences: An adopting slot reuses one authoritative imported ancestor and never overrides it.
Every invalid marker, non-slot duplicate, independent-owner collision, structural difference, or equal unmarked redeclaration refuses compilation.
constraints: Require literal Boolean annotations.adopts:true and exact typed source equality before defaults or normalization, removing only top-level description, annotations.adopts, and an annotations map left empty.
Import or source order never selects a winner.

why: CC-X02 proves the bundled duplicate and marker surface. The selected rule preserves intentional owner reuse while refusing implicit merge, normalization, coercion, multiple ownership, and order-dependent override.
